buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract

quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address PCP DTE CWC Sewa Bhawan R K Puram New Delhi . 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Generic Products supplied shall be nontoxic and harmless to health. In the case of toxic materials, Material Safety Data Sheet may be furnished along with the material. 8. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. QUALIFICATION CRITERIA (QC) A. Invitation of Bid is open to eligible Bidders fulfilling the following: a. Bidder should have certificates of valid GSTIN and PAN.

b. The Bidder should not be, blacklisted by any Central / State Govt. Organization / Department / Ministry of Govt. of India / PSU. B. Bidder must comply with all the criteria as mentioned at ‘Clause 1.A’ above. Noncompliance of any of th e criteria shall result in rejection of the bid. Any hiding / mis-representation of facts shall result in rejection of the bid and forfeiture of Bid Security. 2. TURNOVER CRITERIA a. Minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during last three financial years i.e., 2023- 24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 shall be as per GeM defined condition. b. Certified audited balance sheets for 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26, issued by Chartered Accountan t /Cost Accountant, shall be submitted. c. Exemption from above criteria shall be as per GeM defined condition. 3. EXPERIENCE OF SIMILAR ORDERS a. The Bidder shall have experience in supply of similar category products and services to any Central/State Govt. Organization/PSU over the last three years i.e., the current financial year and the last three financial years (ending month of March prior to the bid opening). b. Past experience of Similar category products and services shall be as per GeM defined condition. c. The Bidder shall submit customer satisfaction letter(s) along with the concerned Letter of Award (Lo A)/Contract Order against its successfully completed work orders in Government Organization(s)/Publi c Sector Undertaking(s) (PSUs) executed during last three years. d. Exemption from above criteria shall be as per GeM defined condition. 4. TECHNICAL BID a. The Technical Bid shall comprise of the following: i. Scanned copy of PAN and GSTIN for fulfilling the condition as per “Clause 1.A.a” under Qualification Criteria (QC) of the tender document. ii. Signed declaration regarding non-Blacklisting as per “Clause 1.A.b” under Qualification Criteria (QC) of the tender document. iii. Proof of turnover details during last three financial years as specified in GeM condition of the tende r document. iv. Scanned copies of Letter of Award(s) / Work Order(s) and letter of successful completion for each o f the similar work orders as specified in GeM condition of the tender document. b. The Technical Bid shall be complete in all respects and contain all information asked for in this doc ument. c. Client reserves the right to verify the uploaded documents with original one. d. Bids / bid related documents submitted after the stipulated deadline shall not be considered for eva luation. 5. ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS a. The successful bidder or their representative shall have to visit PCP Dte, CWC, Sewa Bhawan, R. K. Puram, New Delhi in on all working days for collecting orders. b. The rates quoted shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, duties, levies, packaging, handling, and d elivery charges up to the destination i.e., PCP Directorate, CWC, Sewa Bhawan, R. K. Puram, New Delh i. c. If any product (e.g., rubber stamps, name plates, etc.) supplied or services rendered by the firm are found to be substandard or not in conformity with the specifications, the same shall be rejected, and n o payment shall be made for such items. The supplier shall replace the rejected items within 3 workin

g days at no extra cost. d. If the order is delayed without valid justification, a penalty of 1% of the order value per day, subject to a maximum of 10% of the total order value, may be imposed unless waived off by the competent a uthority. e. The successful bidder shall ensure supply of the ordered products strictly within three (3) working d ays from the date of receipt of the confirmed order. Delays beyond this period may attract penalty an d/or cancellation of the order. f. In case of consistent delay in supplies, repeated non-compliance, or unsatisfactory service, the dep artment reserves the right to terminate the contract without assigning any reason. The decision of the department in this regard shall be final and binding. g. The department also reserves the right to reject any or all quotations/bids without assigning any re asons whatsoever and is not liable to entertain any correspondence in this regard. h. The bidder must ensure compliance with all applicable government regulations, statutory obligation s, and safety standards in force during the execution of the contract. i. The firm shall not sublet, transfer, or assign the contract or any part thereof to any other party witho ut prior written permission of the department. j. The bidder shall provide a single point of contact (with mobile number and email) for all order, deliv ery, and coordination matters. The nominated person should be accessible during working hours. k. No advance payment shall be made. Payments will be released only after successful delivery and in spection/acceptance of the goods by the department. l. Bidders may attend the pre-bid meeting, as specified in the bid document, to gain an overview and understanding of the scope of services to be provided. m. The contract can be extended for a period of one year subject to mutual consent and satisfactory p erformance. n. The bidder shall maintain a record of the goods and services supplied to the department and paym ent will be processed after verification of the monthly records.. o. The bidder shall submit ISO 9001:2015 and 14001:2015, failure to this may lead to rejection of the bid. The originality of the documents submitted can be checked with proof. .
